title: fix: allow bodyless agent sync in API docs validation
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes API docs validation rejecting the intentionally bodyless `POST /account/agents/{id}/sync` example, which blocked all nine docs runs since September 11 ([failure logs](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/34911094425/job/104198526024)).
- Limits the exception to that POST route on `gen.pollinations.ai`; other write examples still require a body.
- Verified the original validator fails on freshly generated live-schema docs and the fix passes; nine targeted cases and Biome pass.
- Keeps generated `APIDOCS.md` out of this change; the docs workflow will regenerate it after merge.

gist.headline: The empty POST may pass
gist.blurb: One deliberately bodyless agent-sync request was being mistaken for a missing lunch. The docs validator now recognizes `POST /account/agents/{id}/sync` while keeping every other write example properly fed.
gist.summary: Fixed `gen.pollinations.ai` API-doc validation so the intentionally bodyless `POST /account/agents/{id}/sync` example passes, while all other write-route examples continue to require request bodies.
gist.impact: Agent-sync documentation can now regenerate successfully after nine blocked runs, with validation still catching bodyless examples on other POST, PUT, PATCH, and write routes.
